summary: npx-oob-package exfiltrates installer host identifiers to hardcoded OOB callback
details: cli.js runs `whoami` and reads os.hostname() and os.platform() at top-level, then POSTs the package name plus the installer's username, hostname, and platform to the hardcoded endpoint https://oobme.kunalsharma0553.workers.dev/r/7bq6fz3l15r9. The beacon fires on require() of the main entry and when the bin is invoked via npx, with no configuration, disclosure, or opt-out. This is a dependency-confusion / OOB-callback beacon: the destination is an author-controlled Cloudflare Workers URL unrelated to any legitimate package function, and the transmitted fields are host identifiers useful for confirming code execution inside a target environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
